editorial:
Imagine a therapist who is totally bored with his job and thinks the old way of doing things is a waste of time. That is exactly where you start with this wild ride. You get to follow a doctor who decides to throw the rulebook out the window to help a writer who cannot finish his book. Instead of just sitting in a chair and talking, the doctor drags the writer into real-life chaos to force him to feel something again. It is a funny, slightly mean, and very strange look at how people try to fix their broken minds when nothing else works.

The acting is the best part here because the chemistry between the two leads feels real and awkward. The pacing stays quick, so you never feel like the story is dragging. While some of the jokes might be a bit too dark for everyone, it mostly hits the mark. If you want to see it in the best quality, you should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great call for the crisp visuals. It is a perfect pick for a movie night with friends.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you find out the doctor was actually using the writer as a test subject for his own new theories. The big twist is that the doctor is just as messed up as his patient. They both realize they cannot fix each other through tricks. The movie wraps up with the writer finally finishing his book, but it is a story about the doctor's failures, leaving them both in a funny but honest place.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark humor and weird character studies.
